[color=#ffffff][size=4][u][b]Notes/Notas:
[/b][/u][/size][/color][u][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]1.0.0[/size][/color][/b][/u][/center][img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - If there are any mistakes, please let me know as soon as you can so I can fix them as soon as possible.
[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP] [/b]- Si hay algunos errores, por favor hágame saber tan pronto como puedas para que pueda arreglarlos lo antes posible.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - The original mod currently only adds 2 NPCs.  It is currently being worked on by BURAKMESE for a 3rd NPC kid.[/size]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP] [/b]- El mod original actualmente solo agrega 2 NPCs. Actualmente, BURAKMESE está trabajando en él para un tercer niño NPC.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - The two NPCs that have been added as of now (Ver: 1.0.1) are Adrian, son of Pierre and Caroline, and Douglas, the Wizard's son.[/size]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP][/b] - Los dos NPCs que se han agregado a partir de ahora (Ver: 1.0.1) son Adrian, hijo de Pierre y Caroline, y Douglas, el hijo del Mago.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - The mod contains special dialogue for each child NPC. Location Events are planned to arrive in the near future. Festival locations are also being added.[/size]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP][/b] - El mod contiene un diálogo especial para cada niño NPC. Está previsto que los eventos de ubicación lleguen en un futuro próximo. También se están agregando lugares para festivales.
[/size]
[b][u][center][color=#6aa84f][size=4]1.0.0-[/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]A[/size][/color][/center][/u][/b][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - Added a version to optional files that will adjust Douglas's dialogue accordingly if you married the Wizard. (Basically, if you have the "Romanceable Rasmodius" mod)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP][/b] - Agregué una versión a los archivos opcionales que ajustará el diálogo de Douglas en consecuencia si te casas con el Mago. (Básicamente, si tienes el mod "Romanceable Rasmodius")

[/size][b][u][center][color=#6aa84f][size=4]1.[/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]1.0[/size][/color][/center][/u][/b][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - I added a folder named "Tina" for the new NPC kid that has just been added by BURAKMESE that has all her dialogue files (translated to Spanish of course) inside. 
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP][/b] - Agregué una carpeta llamada "Tina" para la nueva niña NPC que acaba de ser añadida por BURAKMESE que tiene todos sus archivos de diálogo (traducidos al español por supuesto) adentro.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ENG][/b] - Tina is the new daughter of Robin and Demitritus. She's close friends with Adrian and she's not very fond of ice cream.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [b][ESP][/b] - Tina es la nueva hija de Robin y Demitritus. Es muy amiga de Adrian y no le gusta mucho el helado.
[/size]

How to install/Cómo instalar:[/center][/size][/b][/u][img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - Download BURAKMESE's original mod + all it's dependencies and follow it's install instructions.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP][/b] - Descarga el mod original de BURAKMESE + todas sus dependencias y siga sus instrucciones de instalación.

[/size][/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - Download this mod and extract the .zip file.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP][/b] - Descarga este mod y extrae el archivo .zip.[/size][/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - Open your mods folder then open "Stardew Kids Expansion" (If you left all three "NPC" folders together). If not find "[NPC] Adrian (Pierre And Caroline)", "[NPC] Douglas (Wizard)", and "[NPC] Tina(Robin And Demetrius)" individually.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP][/b] - Abra su carpeta de mods y luego abra "Stardew Kids Expansion" (Si dejó las tres carpetas "NPC" juntas). Si no, busque "[NPC] Adrian (Pierre And Caroline)", "[NPC] Douglas (Wizard)", y "[NPC] Tina(Robin And Demetrius)" individualmente en su carpeta de mods.[/size][/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - Delete the "content.json" from inside both NPC folders and replace them with the new "content.json" files from inside this translation's "Adrian", "Douglas", and "Tina" folders.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/r6bLJ7K/Base-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP][/b] - Elimine el "content.json" del interior de ambas carpetas NPC y reemplácelos con los nuevos archivos "content.json" del interior de las carpetas "Adrian", "Douglas", y "Tina" de esta traducción.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - Next, open the "assets" folder for each main mod folders and delete the "Dialogue" folders, then, replace them with this translation's "Dialogue" folders.[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DLRF8jN/Sunset-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ESP][/b] - Después, abra la carpeta "assets" para cada carpeta principal del mod y elimine las carpetas "Dialogue", luego, reemplácelas con las carpetas "Dialogue" de esta traducción.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - That's it! Enjoy![/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0myL82k/Chocolate-Cake-36x36.png[/img] [size=3][b][ENG][/b] - ¡Eso es todo! ¡Disfruta![/size][/size][/size]
